source_evidence: Player exact 'Let send the evidence' in the immediate D325 Nightglass map-room context authorizes forwarding documentary comparison to Coris for the contracted milestone, not another unrelated disclosure, surrender of originals, expenditure or claimed payout. Scoped owner prep dm-estate-ancestry.md @582dd9cfe965575548562916b606e5965813b522 permits preserved copy and chosen recipient for documentary assessment; Coris previously introduced at Nightglass, Edric's written field-book request actually received by this keeper in preceding accepted scene. Newly adjudicated routine forwarding: keeper authenticates duplicate, Mara supplies comparative notes, seals and accepts packet addressed Coris care of Edric with ordinary outgoing reply under existing request, no fee billed to V, no exact route duration or actual onward dispatch/receipt established. No roll required for authorized ordinary preparation. No monetary, rest, feature, or other custody change. D325~19:00 Orsaven map room, V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar present, ordinary city visit completed after D325~17:25 Desen financial review. V explicitly thanks Desen and chooses both Crown invitation delivery and Nightglass map-room inquiry today. At~17:50 ordinary royal correspondence receiving office still has a duty clerk; V presents limited authenticated messenger credentials and physically delivers original SEALED Crownsunder preliminary invitation, clerk accepts into authorized royal dispatch custody and issues ordinary dated acknowledgment of receipt. V retains messenger credentials and receipt; no personal monarch audience, ministerial reading, policy answer, agreement, fee or disclosed Kestrel evidence; delivery task completed, official response pending. Ossent's established cooperation condition remains suspension of Crownsunder's throne claim; Crownsunder has not conceded; no V power to negotiate binding terms. At~18:15 map-room keeper finishing work receives the party, checks collection correspondence, confirms actual receipt of Edric's signed D290 field-book request (prior transit not claimed as previously verified), permits supervised inspection and copying of nonrestricted post-Convergence survey. Mara's Hall carrier-mark/packing notes compare with identical mark on depicted hauling frame beside collapsed western Ossent crossing; two banks, surviving pier and broken aqueduct alignment locate last documented recovery/packing district of the silver-veined heart. Keeper authenticates field-book copy/sketch from actual collection custody, Mara retains it with comparative annotations; original field book stays collection, Hall originals and heart remain at Nightglass/Severin. Not proof of maker, bloodline, father's death, heart speaker or exact ancient site functions. Actual itinerary 48 road miles +12 rough miles, ~3 days each way under ordinary conditions, not guaranteed. No expedition yet undertaken, no further ancient-site secrets revealed. At V's express request Mara and keeper prepare a separate authenticated duplicate of the matching field-book extract/sketch and comparative Hall packing/carrier-mark notes for Coris Tallen, care of the established Nightglass Hall steward Edric. Keeper accepts sealed packet into his outgoing reply to Edric's actual D290 request for onward return via established commercial post/priority relay where supported; no additional fee charged to V as part of that existing correspondence. Physical forwarding custody transferred to keeper, next outbound dispatch pending, no actual bird release, recipient receipt, exact ETA, claim approval or remittance yet. Mara retains her authenticated copy and notes, all originals remain with their respective custodians; no unrelated Kestrel or private material disclosed. Documentary300gp contingent on Coris assessment remains unpaid, optional800gp field milestone unearned. Edric's other correspondence and Severin assent remain unconfirmed. The Ferrymen's Share financial-trail inquiry open: Desen identified pre-death account4-C payment to local shipwright for two ferry hulls; yard directions given, voluntary visit tomorrow possible, no warrant, recovery or evidence custody change. Quenwood life sentence upheld; assets frozen; no restitution yet distributed. Both D325 magic orders accepted, deposits140+120 paid, target353 local collection; balances280+240=520 not paid; no reserved purse or finished magic items. Serpent Dart supplier not secured. Purse2051gp8sp6cp, rations21/feed28, LR5/6; no second inn booking or D325 overnight yet. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone; Cirren51/51 AC19 +1 Shield equipped old ordinary shield retained HD6/6 slots4/2/3 CD2/2 boots; Fenar59/59 AC16 breastplate and Insignia HD6/6 Rage3/4 inactive Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40, natural attack+9, greataxe unaffected. Mara and coach/four horses healthy, animals at Copper Hart. Separate Crown intelligence commission introduction retained,300+1300 contingent, Kestrel originals V and other evidence custody unchanged, Elara Caereth. V dice delegated. Await V's next choice as keeper closes the map room at~19:00; no assumed inn payment, rest, reply, expedition or further action.
